comentarios: First record of Cocha Antshrike for Colombia, discovered by myself and Jurgen Beckers. Songs of a male and female responding aggressively to playback in dense understory (about 1.5 -2 m off the ground) of streamside forest (the forest is presumably flooded at this spot for most of the year; water levels were very low). A third bird was singing just across the stream, presumably in response to this pair. Photographic documentation on eBird checklists.
